about: Two pieces: the Brain Dump swim line, and idea-lamp with two new tagged lines. u1 migrates the swim line. The record's could_not entry names Ideas/idea-lamp.md and no line: the run couldn't read that story note. Every line of idea-lamp stays off the handled list, and none is listed under Other notes as a line the run did nothing with, so the log has no Other notes section. The swim line and its copy go on.
spec: plan-run-manager.md Milestone 17, first checkbox, item 5 ('a could_not entry naming a story note and no line keeps every line of it off the handled list and out of that list')
readings: A could_not entry that names a story note and no line has a `source` holding only `note`. spec-migrator.md 05.2 gives a source `note`, `line`, `text` 'where one applies', and fixes no form for a note with no line.
This behaviour is what the old code already did for every could_not note; the case keeps it from being lost. On the old code it fails only on the history entry's `renamed`.
